+        """Create a DoDoer that polls one witness mailbox for SSE messages.
+            hab (Hab | GroupHab): Local identifier used to authenticate mailbox queries.
+            witness (str): Witness AID whose advertised mailbox endpoint to contact.
+            topics (Iterable[str]): Mailbox topics whose sequence cursors to request.
+            msgs: Legacy output-queue option; None creates a fresh message Deck.
+            retry (int): Initial reconnect delay in milliseconds, updated by SSE retry.
+            version (Versionage | None): Query protocol version and default genus choice.
+            gvrsn (Versionage | None): Explicit attachment genus override.
+            kind (str | None): Query body encoding; default JSON permits slash-containing
+            mailbox topic names independently of protocol/genus selection.
+            None. The caller schedules/removes this doer and owns the habitat lifecycle.
+            Construction performs no network request; eventDo handles endpoint discovery."""
self.gvrsn = version if gvrsn is None else gvrsn
+        # Mailbox topic names contain slashes, which are not CESR map labels.
+        # Keep protocol/genus selection independent from the JSON body kind.
+        self.kind = Kinds.json if kind is None else kind
self.msgs = None if msgs is not None else decking.Deck()

stream, ims. Upon completion returns extracted parsed msg substream as
dictionary where substream is msg plus attachments which attachments

not framed and then eventually the `yield from` completes by returning
dict of parsed msg substream Use the existing request/receipt/public-method contracts reached by native lifecycle flows, preserving exact protocol metadata, framing, and process failure status.

NATIVE.title: Native evidence validation and independent sections
NATIVE.rationale: Reuse one authenticated native verification path; evidence availability, schema validation, graph interpretation, and local policy remain distinct. Preserve exact disclosed bytes and existing wire/profile decisions.
NATIVE.limits: Pinned profile resolves specific ambiguous wire contracts; it is not universal conformance. Comparison donor frameworks are not presumed copied.

CUSTODY.title: Optional per-registry private derivation and thin inventory
CUSTODY.rationale: Keep grant-specific consent and issued bytes in ordinary storage; separate optional encrypted salt handling, require explicit opening verification, and retain exact history without a current-standing claim.
CUSTODY.limits: Locksmith informs the small reference model; no runtime code dependency or per-symbol copying is inferred. Keeper rotation does not migrate custody; plaintext re-import is recovery.

SERVICES.title: Registrar hosting and independent observer acquisition
SERVICES.rationale: Reuse ordinary KEL/TEL authentication and service routing, while making source acquisition independent of presentation/cache queries and scheduling maintenance with the concrete owner.
SERVICES.limits: Module headers attest donor route/topology adaptation. Exact copied-snippet ancestry is not independently proven for every new method; this remains an explicitly bounded donor-attribution uncertainty, not an assertion of direct copying.

GROUP.title: Explicit native group approval and shared evidence ownership
GROUP.rationale: Compose existing GroupHab/Counselor/Multiplexor/StreamPoster owners. Receiving proposals does not supply local approval; share parser schema evidence and give each Kramer one pruning owner.
GROUP.limits: Local explicit consent and quorum behavior do not create a new multisig protocol or automatically delegate private custody.

TRANSPORT.title: Existing transport/CLI boundary adaptations
TRANSPORT.rationale: Use the existing request/receipt/public-method contracts reached by native lifecycle flows, preserving exact protocol metadata, framing, and process failure status.
TRANSPORT.limits: Only the actual changed functions/snippets in the inventory are covered; nearby untouched upstream implementation remains inherited.

CLI.title: Native command selection and local capability composition
CLI.rationale: Select existing concrete protocol owners from explicit CLI intent, retain ordinary identity authentication, and make custody provisioning/derivation optional rather than an inventory prerequisite.
CLI.limits: Working CLI changes remain WIP until their parent-owned validation and provenance pass are reconciled.

DOLLY.title: Dolly application extraction
DOLLY.rationale: Separate authenticated protocol verification from reportable selection, current standing, retained-view projection, and actual hook delivery. Move application ownership to kentbull/dolly.
DOLLY.limits: Source owner supplied a literal-copy/import-rewrite move map. New standalone transport/schema/CLI symbols belong to the Dolly repository ledger and are not silently attributed to the former KERIpy module.

INFRA.title: Copied Linux qualification and installed peer scenarios
INFRA.rationale: Install and test an actual artifact in Linux-owned image/state storage, with pinned real legacy peers and explicit operational transcripts.
INFRA.limits: Infrastructure reproducibility and passing scenarios do not establish universal conformance or production readiness.
